android.desc:
Price of Time shows the true cost of any purchase, not just in money, but in the hours spent earning it and the literal days of your life.
Point your camera at a price tag or enter the amount manually to instantly see how many hours and days of your life it actually costs.

HOW IT WORKS
Enter your salary, other income, working hours, and monthly expenses. Price of Time will calculate your true hourly rate after deducting rent, utilities, and groceries, then translate any price into actual work hours.

FEATURES
• Online & Offline Mode – Works perfectly without an internet connection
• Price Scanner — Point your camera and get instant results (your personal time cost calculator)
• Manual Input — Enter any amount manually and convert money to hours
• Decision Mode — Save, Buy, or Postpone (your ultimate impulse buying saver)
• History – All your decisions tracked in one place
• Wishlist – Easily return to the items you want to buy
• Targets – Setup your targets and track your progress
• Achievements – Earn achievements and track your progress
• Statistics — Track mindful spending and see exactly where your money and precious time go
• Excel Export – Export your data to view or edit on any device

SUBSCRIPTION
• 100% Ad-free
• Full-year history
• Unlimited Targets
• Unlimited Postponed/Wishlist items
• Export all purchases to an Excel file

Start seeing prices for what they truly are.
